[size=4][b]⚚ Description[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Technically, this is not a full-fledged mod, but I wanted to share portraits for Dale's character, even though he was originally created only for personal use. But after thinking about it, I decided that maybe someone would like it and come in handy, for example, those who also like this character, but they want to update his appearance, but there are no mods for him at all.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]The "Mod" is only for changing the character's portrait, it consists only of the png version. Since I don't understand programming at all.[/color]

[color=#3c78d8][size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#3c78d8]1) Download the "Dale Portraits" file. 2) Disk where you installed the game/Stardew valley/Mods/Portraiture/Pull out all the folders from "Dale Portraits" and put them in "Portraits"[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Main features[/b]
Replaces standard character images.[/color]

[color=#a4c2f4][font=Georgia][i]I hope someone will find this useful[/i][/font] (▀ Ĺ̯▀ )[/color]
